answer: Each seat is a sealed ferrous canister bolted to its own reef, holding a quartz plate whose resonant drift records local salinity and temperature. A shore beacon pings at unpredictable times, and the canister must answer with a signed reading of that drift; the echo delay also proves the hardware sits where it claims. A sybil farm thus needs one boat trip, one canister and one reef per identity, plus months of real seawater before its drift matures. Ten thousand fake agents mean ten thousand deployments that cannot be virtualised, so a vote costs more than it can ever earn.
